# Adapters

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_adapters_md.py. Do not edit by hand: run `make adapters-md`. -->

Every adapter wraps a free public API that needs no key. Enable a group of them with
`--toolsets` (or `KEYLESS_MCP_TOOLSETS`); the default is all. To add one, see
[docs/adapter-contract.md](docs/adapter-contract.md).

**9 adapters, 18 tools.**

Toolsets with no adapters yet (they are valid for `--toolsets` and serve no tools until the first adapter lands): `finance`, `fun`.

## About the agent pass rate

Each prompt is a plain-English question that never names a tool; the rate is how many trials a real agent picked the right tool and called it successfully (passed/total). A dash means no prompt covers that adapter. One model on one day, not a stable rate.

- `codex`: model `gpt-6.1-sol`, 1 trial(s) per prompt, run on 2026-10-11.
